card.name: Quantity word after 'had' before 'to do with'
card.fires_on: Quantifier words like no, nothing, much or little right after have/had, setting up a phrase like 'no connection', 'nothing in common' or 'nothing to do with'. Also relative words such as which or to in definitions of a sign.

modes.label: Had + none/little
modes.description: A negating or quantity word right after had or have, before connection, idea, or 'to do with'.
modes.example: Certainly he had<< nothing>> in common with the strain of Social Democracy

modes.label: Definition linking words
modes.description: Which or to in a definition of a sign, leading into what the sign brings about or stands for.
modes.example: a sign is something, A,<< which>> brings something, B, its interpretant

card.writes: It favors words like deserve, warrant and justification, which fit phrases about what something merits or relates to.
card.plain: It marks the little word after 'had' that says how much connection or relation something has, like 'no' or 'nothing'.
